description: AI Audio settings expose the current documented MiniMax speech models and refresh the account's live Mandarin and English voices with resilient offline state.
steps: Open AI Audio settings with a configured MiniMax key
Refresh the audio catalog
Verify Speech 2.8 models appear before older supported models
Verify friendly Mandarin and English voice choices are populated from MiniMax
Select voices, relaunch, and verify the selections persist
Simulate a failed refresh and verify the last successful catalog remains usable

description: Mandarin and English MiniMax synthesis use explicit language boosts and language-aware cache identities so previews speak the intended language.
steps: Preview Mandarin from AI Audio settings
Verify the request sends Chinese language boost and uses the selected Mandarin voice
Preview English from AI Audio settings
Verify the request sends English language boost and uses the selected English voice
Verify legacy auto-language cached audio is not reused

description: Batch AI Analysis can optionally generate and persist MiniMax pronunciation audio without playback while preserving explanation results on partial failure.
steps: Open Batch AI Analysis
Enable Generate MiniMax audio after reviewing cost and privacy guidance
Run a batch containing uncached and cached terms
Verify explanations and persistent audio outcomes are reported separately
Verify generated audio appears in the saved audio library and cache hits avoid duplicate generation
Cancel a batch and inject a TTS failure to verify safe partial completion

description: The live catalog, previews, and batch audio workflow build and remain adaptive and accessible on macOS, iPhone/iOS, and iPadOS 27 Golden Gate.
steps: Build the macOS target with Xcode 27
Build the generic iOS target with Xcode 27
Build and inspect the workflow on an iPhone simulator
Build and inspect the workflow on an iPadOS 27 simulator
Verify localized loading, error, progress, cost, and completion states

description: Speech playback activates and deactivates AVAudioSession without synchronously blocking the main actor, while preserving request replacement and source-audio handoff ordering.
steps: Start local system narration on iOS 27 and verify playback begins only after asynchronous audio-session activation succeeds
Start saved or newly generated MiniMax audio and verify it uses the same asynchronous activation gate
Stop or replace speech during pending activation and verify stale playback never starts
Hand off from speech to recording or imported-audio playback and verify a stale speech deactivation cannot turn off the new owner
Verify idle speech deactivation uses the asynchronous iOS 27 API with notify-others semantics
Build and run regression checks for macOS, iPhone iOS 27, and iPadOS 27

description: AI translation and OCR cleanup return a parsed one-field structured result, so model commentary, chain-of-thought, labels, and notes can never be displayed, spoken, or saved as the answer.
steps: Configure a cloud provider whose model emits inline <think> reasoning and translate a long passage from the Translate, Photo, or Reader screen
Verify the displayed translation contains no reasoning, preface, label, markdown fence, or trailing translator's note
Ask a reasoning-heavy model to translate an article and verify it renders the passage rather than an outline or summary of it
Translate a passage long enough to have been truncated at the previous 2048-token ceiling and verify the whole translation arrives intact
Force a response that is nothing but commentary and verify an actionable error appears instead of the commentary
Repeat through Ollama and Apple Intelligence and verify all three providers behave identically
Run scripts/test-ai-prompt-contracts.sh and build macOS and iOS with no new warnings

description: An AI translation returns, in the same structured response, a short explanation of what made the passage tricky and the key terms a learner would have to look up, scaled to the passage and excluding elementary vocabulary.
steps: Translate a short easy phrase with an AI provider and verify no notes panel appears
Translate an idiomatic sentence and verify the explanation names the actual difficulty and quotes the source words
Verify the key terms exclude pronouns, particles, numbers, and everyday vocabulary
Translate a long passage and verify the terms are drawn from across the whole text and capped at eight
Switch the interface language and verify the notes are written in the new native language
Save a key term from the notes panel and verify it appears in the vocabulary book
Translate with Apple's on-device engine and verify Explain this translation fetches the notes on demand

description: Recorded and imported audio transcribes even when the locale's on-device dictation model is missing, the recognizer reports availability late, or Speech never answers.
steps: Transcribe a Chinese clip on a device without the Chinese dictation model and verify it falls back to Apple's service instead of failing
Transcribe immediately after switching audio language and verify a transient unavailable recognizer is not rejected
Verify a stalled recognition ends with an actionable timeout instead of an endless spinner
Verify the transcript arrives with sentence punctuation
Verify a failure message carries the underlying Speech error domain and code

description: Audio can be transcribed through a configured AI provider's OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text endpoint and translated in the same flow, with Apple Speech remaining the on-device default.
steps: Open the Multimodal audio pane and verify the engine picker defaults to Apple Speech
Switch to AI Provider with an OpenAI key configured and verify the model field appears
Record a clip, choose Transcribe to Editor, and verify the AI transcript reaches the editor
Choose Translate Audio and verify the transcript is transcribed then translated end to end
Verify the privacy notice changes to say the audio is uploaded and billed
Force an Apple Speech failure and verify Retry with AI and Retry & Translate appear and work
Select AI Provider with no capable provider configured and verify an actionable message appears

description: Selecting the Chinese-speaker-learning-English mode mirrors the whole app: AI explains English headwords in Mandarin with IPA instead of pinyin, the vocabulary list puts the English word in the main font with 中文 beneath, the tappable reader annotates English, Mandarin-only affordances are hidden, and the interface renders in 中文.
steps: Open Settings and pick 中文母语者学英语, then verify the whole interface switches to 中文
Open Translate and verify it starts on 中 to EN and that the English pane is the tappable, word-by-word one with 中文 shown small beneath it
Tap an English word and verify the detail sheet leads with the English word and glosses it in 中文
Open Vocabulary and verify each row shows the English word in the main font with the Chinese gloss in the smaller font, and that the Pinyin sort option is absent
Ask for an AI explanation of an English word and verify the prose is Mandarin and the pronunciation field holds IPA, not pinyin
Read a saved word aloud and verify the English side is spoken
Open Display settings and verify the pinyin and tone-color controls are hidden, and that Practice no longer offers tone drills
Switch back to the English-speaker mode and verify every screen returns to its original Mandarin-learner behavior

description: A toggle in the Batch AI Analysis menu makes every newly saved word or phrase get translated and analyzed automatically by the selected LLM provider, with a deduplicated, capped, relaunch-resumable queue that yields to a manual batch run, pauses after repeated failures, and never generates paid audio.
steps: Open Batch AI Analysis and turn on Auto-Translate New Words
Save a new word from Translate and verify the queue count rises and then falls as it is analyzed
Open that word's AI analysis and verify it appears instantly with no spinner and no new request
Verify the batch screen's Needs Analysis count fell by one without pressing the batch button
Save the same word again from another surface and verify it is not queued or analyzed twice
Turn off every AI provider, save a word, and verify the queue holds it and reports that it is waiting for a provider
Configure a provider again and verify the held word is analyzed without another save
Start a reviewed batch run while words are queued and verify automatic analysis waits until the batch finishes
Quit the app with words still queued, relaunch, and verify the queue resumes rather than losing them
Point the provider at an unreachable endpoint, save several words, and verify the queue pauses itself and shows the error instead of retrying forever
Turn the toggle off and verify no newly saved word is queued or analyzed
Verify no MiniMax audio is generated at any point in the above

description: Recording or importing audio in the Multimodal tab transcribes reliably: Apple Speech installs the locale's on-device model before recognizing (as live dictation already did), and AI transcription uses the provider the user actually selected rather than silently uploading the recording to another configured account.
steps: Open the Multimodal tab and switch the input mode to Audio
With the engine set to Apple Speech, record a short clip and press Transcribe to Editor
On the first run in a language, verify a speech-model download with visible progress appears instead of an apparent hang
Verify the transcript reaches the editor rather than an 'Apple Speech has no recognizer available' error
Repeat with the audio language set to the other language and verify it also transcribes
Switch the engine to AI Provider and verify the pane names the provider the audio will be sent to
Select a provider outside OpenAI/Qwen/Quotio and verify it is used as selected, with a note explaining it may not offer the endpoint
Select a provider with no speech-to-text model set and verify the error names the missing model instead of failing silently
Press Cancel during a transcription and verify it stops promptly
Verify the whole pane renders in 中文 when the interface language is Chinese
